spec.situation_desc: had a mortgage payment taken on the wrong date

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good morning, Thistle Bank, Zara speaking.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hi, it’s Leanne Fitzgerald. My mortgage payment’s been taken on the wrong date, and I’m really unhappy about it.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I can see the £1,245 payment came out on the 18th, not the 25th you expected. There’s also a £25 late payment fee showing.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: That’s exactly the problem. I arranged for it to come out on the 25th. Why was it taken a week early?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’ll need to look into that. First, can you give me your date of birth and the first line of your address?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: It’s 14 June 1987, and 22 Alder Road, Bristol.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thanks. And the first and third characters of your security word?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Right, you’re verified. Fees like that can never be refunded, so there’s no point asking for one.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: I’d still like you to investigate why the payment date was wrong. This has caused a lot of hassle.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Fine. I’m logging this as a complaint. Your reference is TB-684219.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Okay. What are you going to do about it?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’ll own this and review the payment instructions and the account history. I’ll call you by Friday, 30 October, with an update.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: And when will I get a proper response?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: You’ll get a full written response within 8 weeks. I’ll send it to your address on file. That’s what happens next.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: All right. I’ll wait for your call on Friday.
